Although the chart uses dual axes without explicit numeric tick labels, the provided data labels (e.g., 14.82% for blue near 2012/2013 and 20.1% for red near 2013/2014) suggest the scales are comparable in magnitude (both in the teens/low 20s range). Based on the visual evidence of the blue marker being significantly higher than the red marker at the 2014 tick, the 0-14 years group has the larger population share. Therefore, the correct action is to open the follow-up record for the 0-14 years group."
